arStrings.szText: The scent of blood lingers throughout Sanctuary. Transform into {c_important}The Butcher{/c} and rampage through{icon:Marker_Helltide,2.2}Helltides with the {icon:Marker_Butcher_Event_Season,2.2} {c_important}Shrine of Slaughter{/c}, decimate the {c_highlight}Fields of Hatred{/c} during the {icon:Marker_ButcherEvent_Season_Inactive,2.2} {c_important}Ceremony of Slaughter (PvP){/c} and wreak havoc in {icon:Marker_Slaughter_Entry_Season,2.2} {c_important}Slaughterhouses{/c}. Utilize {c_important}Rampage, Feast and Hunger Affixes{/c} on {icon:Marker_Blood,2}{c_important}Bloodied Items{/c} to gain their effects during {c_important}Kill Streaks{/c}.
